subject: alarm clock
title: What If You Hit Snooze Every Morning?

scenes.text: What if you hit snooze every single morning? You might wake up sharper.
You're not alone. In a survey of over seventeen hundred adults, sixty-nine percent snoozed at least sometimes.
So Stockholm scientists brought thirty-one regular snoozers into a sleep lab, and let them snooze for thirty minutes.
Most still slept over twenty of those minutes, and the night's sleep was barely affected.
Right after getting up, snoozers did a bit better on thinking tests. Mood and sleepiness didn't change.
The catch: it only worked for habitual snoozers. If you always need more, you may just need more sleep.

description:
What if you hit snooze every morning? In a 2023 Stockholm University study, 31 habitual snoozers who snoozed for 30 minutes barely lost any sleep and did slightly better on cognitive tests right after waking.
69% of 1,732 surveyed adults snooze at least sometimes. The researchers say it isn't for everyone, especially people who are short on sleep.

first_comment: How many times do you hit snooze? One, three, or you've lost count? What habit should we run through next?
